title: The reducibility direction is reversed in the splitting corollary proof.
details: Miller, December3,2008, §31 Corollary31.3 proof p67, visually checked2026-11-09: after taking C=A it says Ai is not Turing reducible to A. Theorem31.1 instead gives A not Turing reducible to Ai. Proposition31.2 proves Ai is Turing reducible to A. Replace the reversed comparison; if one piece were computable, the other would compute their union A, contradicting the corrected comparison. The corollary remains valid. The Sacks splitting entry adopts the corrected comparison and uses the disjoint-union join reductions for the strictness and incomparability consequences. The source version retains the reversed line.
